title: Governed security exception (waiver) record
description: Validates serialized exception/waiver records (Batch 7, Task D; Sections 6 and 18). expires_at is REQUIRED — permanent exceptions cannot be expressed. Records are stored in the exception_records DB table; this schema governs their serialized/interchange form.

policy_family.description: Governed policy family this exception covers (e.g. security_policy).

rule_id.description: Specific rule waived; null or '*' covers the whole family.

expires_at.description: REQUIRED (Section 18: exceptions have expiration times). Must be after granted_at; enforced by the model validator.
